newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen heading upwards, HP to drag techs.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen heading upwards, HP to drag techs.

text.p: Wall Street is seen opening higher on Friday, continuing Thursday afternoon's momentum despite a possible drag on the technology stocks from Hewlett- Packard Co's lower-than-expected earnings.
On Thursday, a late session rally pushed the Dow to a new high of 7334, up about 47 points.
Analysts said they expected to see an upward move, though housing start numbers were above expectations.

Total starts were up 2.6 percent to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.47 million in April after a revised 7.7 percent drop to 1.43 million in March, the department said. Wall Street analysts had forecast April housing starts at a rate of 1.43 million a year.
